# 💳 Firecrawl Market Research

💳 Requires a Firecrawl API key — the hosted service is paid (usage-based credits). Curated by Skill Harbor — a full market-research workflow: give it a market or set of companies and it gathers company data, financials, reports, news and SEC filings via the Firecrawl MCP tools, then assembles a structured research deliverable with a 25-attribute product comparison matrix. By @firecrawl, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: it organizes publicly available information into a research brief — it is not financial advice and it won't verify every figure; depth and freshness depend on Firecrawl quota and what's published on the web. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
